PUT THE 3GPP RETRIEVAL INDEX HERE
=================================

Copy the CONTENTS of the tgpp-sqlite-retrieval output folder

    D:\3gpp\tgpp-sqlite-retrieval\dist\retrieval_data\

into THIS folder, so that it looks like this:

    CPARAS_Platform_Revamped\dist\retrieval_data\
        search_index.sqlite      (the ~20 GB database - required)
        schema_version.json      (required)
        manifest.json            (required - also used to check the copy is complete)
        build_report.json
        README.txt
        tgpp_retrieval.py
        PUT_RETRIEVAL_DATA_HERE.txt   (this file; harmless)

Nothing else to configure: leave CPARAS_RETRIEVAL_DATA empty in backend\.env.
The backend opens the files READ-ONLY and never modifies them.

PowerShell (from the project folder; close the app first if it is running):
    robocopy D:\3gpp\tgpp-sqlite-retrieval\dist\retrieval_data .\dist\retrieval_data /E

Then (re)start the app and open the "3GPP Retrieval Index" page - it shows which files were found,
whether the copy is complete (database size is compared with manifest.json) and what the index contains.

Copying the folder up one level (files directly in dist\) also works.
To avoid keeping two 20 GB copies, one app can use this folder and the other can point at it with
its own setting (CPARAS_RETRIEVAL_DATA / IC_RETRIEVAL_DATA in that app's backend\.env).
